mapper.select: select environment_id, cast(command as text) as command, cast(request as text) as request from environment_build_submission where actor_id = #{actor} and idempotency_key = #{key}
mapper.insert: insert into environment_build_submission(actor_id, idempotency_key, environment_id, command, request) values(#{actor}, #{key}, #{environment}, cast(#{command} as jsonb), cast(#{request} as jsonb))
mapper.update: update environment_build_submission set build_id = #{buildId} where actor_id = #{actor} and idempotency_key = #{key} and (build_id is null or build_id = #{buildId})
mapper.insert: insert into build_ownership(build_id, environment_id, tenant_id) select build_id, environment_id, tenant_id from environment_build_submission where tenant_id = #{tenant} and actor_id = #{actor} and idempotency_key = #{key} on conflict(build_id) do update set build_id = excluded.build_id where build_ownership.environment_id = excluded.environment_id and build_ownership.tenant_id = excluded.tenant_id

insert into asset_build_scope(tenant_id, build_id, environment_id, repository, branch_name) select tenant_id, build_id, environment_id, request->>'repository', request->>'branchName' from environment_build_submission where tenant_id = #{tenant} and actor_id = #{actor} and idempotency_key = #{key} on conflict(tenant_id, build_id) do update set build_id = excluded.build_id where (asset_build_scope.environment_id, asset_build_scope.repository, asset_build_scope.branch_name) = (excluded.environment_id, excluded.repository, excluded.branch_name)
